candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: New Melones Reservoir is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b) (it appears in §7.50(b) only as the downstream boundary landmark of the Stanislaus River, Middle Fork listing), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). Kokanee (landlocked salmon) are likewise open all year under §5.41(a).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds: five-trout daily bag limit and ten-trout possession limit, counted as the total number of trout in combination. Kokanee salmon are regulated separately under §5.41 and do not count against the trout limit.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit, 10 trout possession limit (all trout species in combination)

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Kokanee (landlocked salmon) are regulated under §5.41, separately from trout under §5.85, and are not counted against the trout bag/possession limit. New Melones Reservoir is not among the §5.41(e) exception waters (Bucks Lake, New Bullards Bar Reservoir, Pardee Lake, Trinity Lake), so the general five/ten landlocked-salmon limit applies.

candidates.summary: Kokanee (landlocked salmon): 5 daily bag limit, 10 possession limit — a separate limit from trout

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists New Melones Reservoir (Region 3, Calaveras Co.) for fingerling-size Kokanee Salmon under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of April-June. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists New Melones Reservoir (Region 4, Calaveras Co.) for sub-catchable-size Brown Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of January-April & October-December (a split range that does not fit a single start-end month window). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists New Melones Reservoir (Region 4, Calaveras Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of January-April & October-December (a split range that does not fit a single start-end month window). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
